About
No Hander · a downhill game about letting go. Built with three.js r160 (MIT license, © 2010-2024 three.js authors). Type: Barlow Condensed (© 2017 Jeremy Tribby) and Rubik (© 2015 Hubert & Fischer, Meir Sadan, Cyreal), both under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, embedded as subsets.
